questions.q: The editorial describes a man who spoke with pride of his grandfather’s rank. What had this pride cost him?
options: It kept him from education and useful work, leaving him poor
Yes. Pride in ancestry stood in his own way.
It took all his time in ceremonies
Not quite. The article says: It kept him from education and useful work, leaving him poor.
It lost him his inheritance in court
Not quite. The article says: It kept him from education and useful work, leaving him poor.
It made his relatives envy him
Not quite. The article says: It kept him from education and useful work, leaving him poor.
questions.rationale: “The psychology which went with being one of a noble lineage had prevented him from either acquiring a good education or engaging himself in some profitable business.”
